approach: Native x86-64 execution of the PS4 executable, reimplemented system libraries, Vulkan renderer (shadPS4 video core)
notes: Boots, renders, controller works, sound effects, ATRAC9 music and the in-game volume settings work, launcher with folder picker, auto-retry and updates from GitHub Releases. Known issues: a rare crash at startup (the launcher retries), no sound panning, no window or resolution options yet. Tested on one machine and one game version. Needs your own copy of the game; none is included. Fork of gow3_pc.
